name: News and headline feeds
summary: Tag a headline for relevance to a stated beat and assign its topic.

input.state: The beat's description followed by the headline and its source.

relevant.instructions: The headline belongs on the beat the state describes.
relevant.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

criteria.other: No supplied topic fits better than the residual.

outputs.shape: a topic label per relevant headline, or 'filtered'

cost.bound: two questions per headline; the beat is stated once per batch

uncertainty.abstain: a low-confidence topic keeps the 'other' residual rather than forcing a label
uncertainty.refusal: a refused item reports refused and stays out of the feed

limits: Relevance is to the stated beat, not a general notion of importance.
Headline text only - the recipe does not fetch the article body.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
